data.gender_notes: Maiza is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Ma'iz means 'strong' and Al-'Aza means 'mother'. Maiza is a feminine name derived from this root, signifying the strength and power of a mother. The name Maiza carries the meaning “Mother of the strong” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maiza usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of the strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_urdu.name: مائزا
